technique_name: Summarize an article on the effects of fossil fuels on the environment.
description: Fossil fuels are a major cause of air, water, and land pollution, and are a leading contributor to climate change. The burning of these fuels is accelerating climate change, which is resulting in increased extreme weather and rising sea levels.
example: The burning of fossil fuels has caused air pollution, water pollution, and land pollution. It has also accelerated climate change, leading to more extreme weather conditions and sea levels rising.
